query_normalized: the impact of social media algorithm transparency on user well-being psychology
rationale: The paper focuses on detecting coordinated behavior and disinformation spread during an election, which is a distinct construct from "algorithm transparency" and "user well-being." While both topics exist within the broader domain of social media, this work does not measure the mechanism of transparency, the psychological outcome of well-being, or the specific causal link between them, failing to meet any of the inclusion criteria (a-f).
